description: Convert a document (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, JSON) into clean, compact, AI-ready Markdown using PackForAI. Provide either a local file `path` or a public `url`. Returns the compact Markdown plus a token comparison, ready to read or paste into a prompt. Use `ocr: true` for scanned / image-only PDFs.

full.description: Return the full document.md (e.g. complete spreadsheet tables) instead of the compact version. Defaults to false.

ocr.description: Force OCR for scanned or image-only PDFs (Pro). Defaults to false.

path.description: Absolute path to a local document file to convert.

url.description: Public https URL of a document to fetch and convert.

name: convert_document
title: Convert a document to clean, AI-ready Markdown
